info.title: Ti Phase 4C Personal Bank User Counts Compatibility Delta
info.description: Self-contained Java overlay for the API and Web aliases of the learning-owned personal-bank user-counts read. The two legacy GET implementations are present but remain pending until full target parity closes; HEAD and OPTIONS are explicitly documented derived HTTP behavior. Production cutover remains disabled.

targetSession.name: ti_dev_session
targetSession.description: Authoritative target Session. The production cookie name is __Host-ti_session.

legacyFlaskSession.name: session
legacyFlaskSession.description: Temporary kill-switched signed Flask Session accepted only after authoritative exchange.

legacyBearer.description: Temporary kill-switched request-only legacy Bearer credential; it never creates or extends a target Session.

BankId.name: bank_id
BankId.description: One nonempty segment of Unicode decimal digits (General_Category=Nd), strictly percent-decoded once and normalized by decimal digit value. Leading zeros are ignored for numeric classification. Zero reaches authentication and rate limiting then returns 403 without an application call; 1 through 2147483647 reaches the application; larger values reach authentication and rate limiting then return safe 500 without an application call. Negative, empty, non-Nd, extra-segment and trailing-slash targets are converter 404 before the route limiter. Encoded slash and literal or encoded semicolon are firewall 400 before the route limiter.

x-ti-coercion.normalization: per-code-point decimal digit value to bounded ASCII representation

aboveIntegerMaximum.boundedParse: length and lexical comparison before integer conversion

QType.name: q_type
QType.description: The first repeated value wins. Missing defaults to the empty string. Trim; case-insensitive all means no type filter; every other unknown value resolves to essay.

Source.name: source
Source.description: The first repeated value wins. Missing defaults to all. Only exact lowercase favorites and mistakes are special; every other value resolves to all.

Tag.name: tag
Tag.description: The first repeated value wins. Missing defaults to the empty string. Only exact lowercase all bypasses filtering; every other nonempty value is a normalized learning-owned tag filter.

RequestId.description: Validated request correlation identifier; when a JSON body is present it equals request_id.

Vary.description: Merged token set. API ordinary responses contain Origin and Cookie; Web responses contain Cookie; API preflight additionally contains Access-Control-Request-Method and Access-Control-Request-Headers.

AccessControlAllowHeaders.description: Only the requested case-insensitive subset of Authorization, Content-Type and X-Request-ID.

Success.description: Available learning result. Permission is rechecked before any zero-count or tag-filtered return.

ApiAuthenticationRequired.description: Anonymous or rejected explicit Bearer request after the alias-local user-count limiter. Malformed, duplicate, bad-signature, expired, stale, revoked, missing and locked cases use the same enumeration-resistant body and never fall back to cookies. All four rate headers describe the charged route decision.

WebLoginRedirect.description: Missing Session or any explicit Authorization on the Web alias is charged to the alias-local IP limiter, then redirects to login before the application. All four rate headers describe the charged route decision.

ApiForbidden.description: Either a charged terminal permission/zero-bank denial or an uncharged empty CORS rejection. X-Request-ID, Vary and the three security headers are common to both variants; rate headers are not guaranteed by this umbrella response.

ApiBusinessForbidden.description: Terminal permission denial or zero bank ID after authentication and the alias-local user-count limiter. All four rate headers describe the charged route decision.

ApiCorsForbidden.description: Unallowlisted API Origin rejected before authentication, rate limiting, Session mutation, application and SQL. The response is empty and has no route rate, Access-Control-Allow-Origin or Set-Cookie headers.

WebForbidden.description: Terminal permission denial or zero bank ID after authentication and the alias-local user-count limiter. All four rate headers describe the charged route decision.

PathFirewallRejected.description: Encoded slash or literal/encoded semicolon rejected before route authentication, limiter and application. The rejected raw target is outside an ordinary legal path-template value.
PathFirewallRejected.x-ti-body-contract: safe response only; no internal exception or rejected value

ApiConverterNotFound.description: Negative, empty, non-Nd, extra-segment or trailing-slash converter miss before the user-count route limiter and application.

WebConverterNotFound.description: The same uncounted converter miss as the API alias. Web defaults to HTML and uses JSON only when the raw Accept header starts with application/json.

ApiRateLimited.description: Either the alias-local user-count route limiter or the earlier Flask Session exchange guard rejected the request. Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Reset are guaranteed; Limit and Remaining depend on the limiter branch.

WebRateLimited.description: Either the alias-local user-count route limiter or the earlier Flask Session exchange guard rejected the request. Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Reset are guaranteed; Limit and Remaining depend on the limiter branch. Web defaults to HTML and uses JSON only when the raw Accept header starts with application/json.

ApiUserCountRouteRateLimited.description: The first breached alias-local user-count fixed window. All four route rate headers describe that one atomic decision.

WebUserCountRouteRateLimited.description: The first breached alias-local user-count fixed window. All four route rate headers describe that one atomic decision.

ApiAuthenticationExchangeRateLimited.description: Flask Session exchange rejected before the user-count route limiter. Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Reset are guaranteed. The attempt-window branch may also emit X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Remaining; neither is guaranteed.

WebAuthenticationExchangeRateLimited.description: Flask Session exchange rejected before the user-count route limiter. Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Reset are guaranteed. The attempt-window branch may also emit X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Remaining; neither is guaranteed.

ApiInternalFailure.description: Safe API JSON for an application failure or a normalized bank ID above Integer.MAX_VALUE. The request is charged to the route limiter; overflow invokes no application or business SQL. All four rate headers describe the charged route decision.

WebInternalFailure.description: Safe charged Web failure for an application failure or normalized overflow. HTML is the default; JSON is selected only when the raw Accept header starts with application/json. All four rate headers describe the route decision.

500 - 服务器错误

发生了一个意外错误，请稍后再试。

ApiServiceUnavailable.description: Fail-closed target authority or rate-store failure. No internal detail and no user-count rate headers are emitted.

WebServiceUnavailable.description: The same fail-closed authority or rate-store failure. Web defaults to HTML and uses JSON only when the raw Accept header starts with application/json.

503 - 服务不可用

服务暂时不可用，请稍后再试。

HeadSuccess.description: GET-equivalent 200 execution with zero response-body bytes.

HeadLoginRedirect.description: GET-equivalent charged Web 302 with Location /login, all four route rate headers and zero response-body bytes.

HeadFirewallRejected.description: GET-equivalent firewall 400 with zero response-body bytes.

HeadAuthenticationRequired.description: GET-equivalent charged API 401 with all four route rate headers and zero response-body bytes.

HeadApiForbidden.description: GET-equivalent API 403 umbrella. X-Request-ID, Vary and the three security headers are common to the charged business denial and uncharged CORS rejection variants.

HeadApiBusinessForbidden.description: GET-equivalent charged API business/zero 403 with all four route rate headers and zero response-body bytes.

HeadApiCorsForbidden.description: GET-equivalent uncharged API CORS 403 with no route rate headers and zero response-body bytes.

HeadWebForbidden.description: GET-equivalent charged Web 403 with all four route rate headers and zero response-body bytes.

HeadConverterNotFound.description: GET-equivalent converter 404 with zero response-body bytes.

HeadRateLimited.description: GET-equivalent Web 429 umbrella with zero response-body bytes. Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Reset are guaranteed; Limit and Remaining depend on the limiter branch.

HeadApiUserCountRouteRateLimited.description: GET-equivalent API user-count route-limit 429 with all four route rate headers and zero response-body bytes.

HeadWebUserCountRouteRateLimited.description: GET-equivalent Web user-count route-limit 429 with all four route rate headers and zero response-body bytes.

HeadApiAuthenticationExchangeRateLimited.description: GET-equivalent API Flask Session exchange 429 with guaranteed Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Reset, plus zero response-body bytes.

HeadWebAuthenticationExchangeRateLimited.description: GET-equivalent Web Flask Session exchange 429 with guaranteed Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Reset, plus zero response-body bytes.

HeadInternalFailure.description: GET-equivalent charged 500 with all four route rate headers and zero response-body bytes.

HeadServiceUnavailable.description: GET-equivalent authority/rate-store 503 with zero response-body bytes and no route rate headers.

ApiOptionsAccepted.description: Bare OPTIONS or valid API preflight. No authentication, rate, Session mutation, application call or SQL.

x-ti-header-variants.bareOptions: Allow, request ID, Vary and security headers; no Access-Control headers without a preflight Origin
x-ti-header-variants.validPreflight: exact ACAO, GET/HEAD/OPTIONS ACAM, requested allowed ACAH subset; no credentials or max-age

WebOptionsAccepted.description: Bare Web OPTIONS. CORS remains disabled and Origin does not create CORS headers.

ApiPreflightRejected.description: Origin, requested method or requested-header set is not allowed. Empty before authentication, rate, Session, application and SQL; no Access-Control or Set-Cookie headers.

OptionsFirewallRejected.description: Ambiguous raw target rejected before route processing.

ApiSuccess.description: Available API learning result. Permission is rechecked before any zero-count or tag-filtered return; an allowlisted simple Origin receives optional Access-Control-Allow-Origin.

HeadApiSuccess.description: GET-equivalent API 200 execution with zero response-body bytes and optional allowlisted Access-Control-Allow-Origin.

HeadApiRateLimited.description: GET-equivalent API 429 umbrella with zero response-body bytes. Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Reset are guaranteed; Limit and Remaining depend on the limiter branch.

HeadApiInternalFailure.description: GET-equivalent charged API 500 with all four route rate headers, optional allowlisted Access-Control-Allow-Origin and zero response-body bytes.

HeadApiServiceUnavailable.description: GET-equivalent API authority/rate-store 503 with optional allowlisted Access-Control-Allow-Origin, zero response-body bytes and no route rate headers.

total.description: Signed JSON integer backed by Java long.

favorites.description: Signed JSON integer backed by Java long; infrastructure/query failure may degrade this optional count field only.

mistakes.description: Signed JSON integer backed by Java long; infrastructure/query failure may degrade this optional count field only.

types.description: Ordered display labels; infrastructure/query failure may degrade this optional field only.

RateLimited.description: Exact fields are status, message, payload, status_code and request_id; payload is null.

x-ti-query-contract.q_type: default empty; trim; case-insensitive all means no filter; unknown means essay
x-ti-query-contract.source: default all; exact lowercase favorites or mistakes are special; every other value means all
x-ti-query-contract.tag: default empty; exact lowercase all bypasses; every other nonempty value is normalized by learning

x-ti-path-contract.unicodeNdAndLeadingZeros: strictly decode once and normalize by numeric digit value
x-ti-path-contract.zero: authenticate and charge alias limiter; 403; no application call
x-ti-path-contract.aboveIntegerMaximum: authenticate and charge alias limiter; safe 500; no application or business SQL
x-ti-path-contract.encodedSlashOrSemicolon: firewall 400; no user-count limiter or application

x-ti-method-contract.get: authenticate, acquire alias-local rate budget, invoke learning application for a positive int bank ID
x-ti-method-contract.head: same path/authentication/actor/rate/application/SQL/status/semantic headers as GET; actual body bytes always zero
x-ti-method-contract.bareOptions: 204 with Allow GET, HEAD, OPTIONS; zero authentication/rate/Session/application/SQL

x-ti-cors-contract.validPreflight: 204 empty before authentication and all side effects
x-ti-cors-contract.invalidOrDisallowedOrigin: 403 empty before authentication and all side effects; no Access-Control or Set-Cookie headers

x-ti-rate-limit-contract.algorithm: atomic Redis fixed windows; stop after first breached window
x-ti-rate-limit-contract.actor: effective TargetAuthenticatedPrincipal; trusted client address only when no valid principal exists
x-ti-rate-limit-contract.keying: domain-separated HMAC-SHA-256 pseudonym with independent secret and namespace
x-ti-rate-limit-contract.storageFailure: fail closed 503 without rate headers or internal details
